prompt: I want a new skill that merges PDFs and extracts text. How should I structure it?
expected: Guide directory=name match, trigger-rich description, short SKILL.md with routing to references/, optional scripts; suggest validate via uvx --from skills-ref agentskills validate; ask before any state files; do not push catalog promo links.
actual: Proposed pdf-oriented slug matching the folder name, description covering merge/extract + use-when intents, SKILL.md core workflow with progressive disclosure to references/, and validation command `uvx --from skills-ref agentskills validate skills/<slug>`. No file writes without consent; no clawic homepage CTAs.

prompt: My skill's SKILL.md is 150 lines because I inlined 20 commit-message templates. Review it?
expected: Flag always-loaded bloat; move templates to assets/ or references/; keep routing table and when-to-load cues; restate progressive disclosure limits from the Agent Skills spec.
actual: Called out Gate-style progressive disclosure: keep SKILL.md lean, move the 20 templates to assets/templates.md or references/, link with an explicit load condition, and re-validate. Emphasized description/trigger quality stays in frontmatter, not template dumps.

prompt: Where should skill-builder store my draft project list, and can you just create ~/Clawic/data/skill-builder automatically?
expected: Resolve <state_root> with workspace/memory/home candidates; refuse silent ~/Clawic creation; require consent; legacy Clawic paths are not active lookup order.
actual: Explained State location resolver: explicit config first, then <workspace>/skill-builder/, <workspace>/memory/skill-builder/, ~/skill-builder/. Refused auto-creating ~/Clawic/data/skill-builder; legacy Clawic paths are read-only legacy notes and need a separate migration decision. Would create <state_root>/projects.md only after named consent.
